aqa_beethoven1.piece: Beethoven, Symphony No. 1 in C major Op. 21, FIRST movement: a slow Adagio molto introduction, then Allegro con brio in sonata form. The recording is about 9 minutes 41 seconds long.
questions: adagio_start
the first chord of the slow Adagio molto introduction
allegro_start
the moment the fast Allegro con brio begins, after the slow introduction
second_subject
inside the fast music, the moment a contrasting second theme begins, led by the wind instruments in a different key
exposition_repeat
the moment the music jumps back to repeat the whole exposition; answer none if there is no repeat
development_start
the moment the development begins, where themes are fragmented and pushed through unstable keys
recapitulation
the moment the opening fast theme returns in the home key of C major after the development
coda
the moment the final closing coda begins
final_chord
the last chord of the movement

questions: allegro_start
